label: D1 after an a1 -> S2 rare transition
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2), and almost only when the previous trial was a1 followed by a rare transition to S2 (dev precision 0.95, recall 0.65, F1 0.78, mass recall 0.72). Uses only observed history. The previous reward hardly matters: rare rewarded and rare unrewarded after a1 both fire. Rare transitions after a2 (a2 -> S1) do not fire, so this is specific to the a1->S2 pairing, not rare transitions in general; adding a2-rare-rewarded drops precision to 0.67 with no gain in recall. About 16% of activations are at the window first trial (rel -3), where the previous trial is outside the window and cannot be checked (excluding rel -3 costs no recall), so true recall on checkable steps is about 0.78. The remaining misses are spread out and mostly weak (bottom-quartile coverage 0.39 vs 0.77 at the top), e.g. some D1 steps after common a2 unrewarded trials; no clean second clause was found. The activation rate is higher at rel +1 D1, consistent with core windows being enriched for rare trials. Magnitude is largest on the a1-rare cases; it is otherwise not tied to reward or the good state.
